documentation.title: Data on public float
documentation.description: Data on public float of listed companies from Iliev (2010).

columns.fdate: Date of end of fiscal year
columns.mr: Indicator for filing of a management report

documentation.details: Five public-float dates have been corrected against the companies' Form 10-K cover pages: Spectrum Control (CIK 92769), fiscal year 2004, and Whitehall Jewellers (CIK 868984), fiscal years 2003--2006. These corrections replace four fractional values of `pfyear` and correct four months, with corresponding updates to `pfdate`. The original source CSV is preserved. The original values, corrected dates, and filing links are recorded in `data-raw/iliev_2010_date_corrections.csv` in the source repository; see also the investigation and filing evidence (https://github.com/iangow/farr/issues/28). Other source anomalies, including invalid dates represented by missing values, remain in the data.
